hed: Kavanaugh denies Missouri map stay as federal judge orders 2025 lines for November
dek: Justice Brett Kavanaugh denied Secretary of State Denny Hoskins’s emergency stay application seeking to reinstate Missouri’s 2025 congressional map after the Missouri Supreme Court ordered the 2022 lines and a November referendum on HB 1. The same day, U.S. District Judge Stephen R. Clark of the Eastern District of Missouri issued a temporary restraining order directing officials to use the 2025 map for the Nov. 3 general election — creating conflicting state and federal orders as ballot and UOCAVA deadlines loom.
alt: Missouri State Capitol dome in Jefferson City
byline: Event summary from public reporting and named outlets

cl.body: Reuters, STLPR, and KOMU emphasize Kavanaugh’s denial, the Missouri Supreme Court’s 2022-map/referendum path, and same-day federal TRO chaos over which lines apply in November.

cr.body: SCOTUSblog, NOTUS, and Fox News frame Hoskins’s denied emergency ask, Judge Clark’s order to keep the 2025 map for November, and GOP warnings of election-administration conflict.

stack_blurb: Conflicting SCOTUS and E.D. Mo. orders on which map applies Nov. 3.
seo_description: Justice Kavanaugh denied Hoskins’s stay of the Missouri Supreme Court map ruling; the same day Judge Stephen Clark ordered use of the 2025 map for Nov. 3.
